summary: Solynta is a non-GMO hybrid potato breeder that supplies hybrid true potato seed instead of seed tubers. It is based in Wageningen, the Netherlands, and was founded in 2007. EW GROUP acquired a majority stake in January 2026.
ownership: Majority stake held by EW GROUP (since 26 January 2026)
markets: USA, Canada and rest of world (sales contact)
facts: Seed rate about 25 grams per hectare, against 2,500 kg of seed tubers
